scripts.e2e: npm run bundle -w @qpq/functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project demo-qpq "npm run e2e -w @qpq/web"
scripts.emulators: npm run bundle -w @qpq/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-qpq
